scope: One fictional job; real Work SDK and unchanged PaymentRight contract; synthetic RAM credential; disposable local Anvil EVM
networkBoundary: Executed with scripts/loopback-only.sb under macOS sandbox-exec; only loopback network access allowed

observed.originalUnavailable: Local primary read interface rejects; original signer ends. Not an HTTP or domain outage.

payment.method: signed transaction on disposable local chain

postClaimSigning.method: actual signMessage call through closed recovered account interface

limitations: This is a new local integration example, not a physical-passkey, browser-profile or public Monad proof.
It does not reinterpret the earlier separately demonstrated public Account Reserve payment as a combined Work/payment result.
The existing contract enforces fixed beneficiary and single collection; it does not attest job completion, client approval or whether payment was earned.
Editing and export do not issue or earn the payment. The fictional entitlement already exists before recovery.
One immutable snapshot; all credentials and encrypted storage exist in one process. No independent infrastructure survival or automatic sync.
Synthetic credentials do not establish real device support, prompt counts, external adoption, production security or sponsor qualification.
Anvil was destroyed after each run; local transaction hashes are not public explorer evidence.
